description: pkix-revocation-http/src/cache.rs: Two `SystemTime::now()` calls in the CRL and OCSP cache-hit liveness checks were replaced with `SystemTime::UNIX_EPOCH + Duration::from_secs(self.inner.now_unix)`. This is a real correctness fix — the previous code used the wall clock for cache expiry while the rest of the validation stack used the caller-supplied `now_unix`. During historical validation or testing with a frozen timestamp, cache entries could expire (or not expire) incorrectly. The fix ensures cache liveness checks are consistent with the rest of the trust decision chain.
title: Good: cache liveness uses caller-supplied time
